purpose: Research planning input, not a runnable CampaignSpec. Run the small-array study first; specify the large-array campaign from its results.
authority: User and scientific planning determine physical inputs and research ranges. Downstream coding agents implement, execute declared configurations, and monitor; they do not select the later large-array science.
legacy_use: Organization and pairing ideas only. The user explicitly reselected tip radii 50 and 100 micrometres.

confirmed_scope.tip_geometry: rounded hemispherical cap joined to a linearly tapered circular section and cylindrical steel shaft

no_spring_mount.support: fixed position and tangent at exposed root
no_spring_mount.exposed_rod_bending: same elastic model and material as paired spring array

exposed_length_rule.default_order: +X leading row is toe, trailing row is heel; interpolate angle by row.
exposed_length_rule.material_rule: Taper fixed in material coordinates; retraction truncates exposed root material even when the taper partly enters ideal guide. Fixed tangent at guide remains the model assumption; fully retracted rod is EXPOSED_LENGTH_LIMIT, not a hard stop.

variable_section.radius: a(u)=r+(0.0005-r)*u/0.002 for 0<=u<=0.002; a=0.0005 beyond; u measured from sphere centre toward root
variable_section.contact_cap: front hemisphere only, not the obscured rear sphere
variable_section.numerical_reference: Cb=integral_0^l u^2/(E*I(u)) du; Kneedle=1/Cb, without sphere-end moment

numerical_scenario_proposals_not_executi.parameter_basis: User-fixed geometry/design/loading; declared steel and friction scenarios.

small_array_proposal.pairing: Identical raw surface, global coordinates, landing and load history within each comparison.

large_array_proposal.design_scope: Only representative designs and pitches selected after the small-array study; retain fixed-mount and spring comparisons.
required_small_stage_outputs: participation and load sharing versus P and N
sustained establishment versus P and S
budgets: fixed pitch with total P / pressure / nominal P per spine reported separately
constraints: Do not assume P required is proportional to N.
Do not assume performance is globally monotone in P.
Reuse equal physical cases under equivalent budget labels.

terrain_plan.strategy: Generate only the surface size required by the current stage. On later large surfaces rerun necessary small-array references for paired scale comparisons.
terrain_plan.margin_definition: Actual full exposed-rod geometry and deformation, tip radius, allowed Y drift and geometry-query margin; may be asymmetric.
terrain_plan.generator_padding: Additional recipe-dependent buffer outside query region.
terrain_plan.same_seed_caution: Changing FFT grid or domain does not preserve the same surface realization.
prohibitions: Do not tile a small periodic patch as an independent large wall.
Do not assign independent walls to individual needles.
Do not normalize each crop separately.
Do not coarsen the grid or shrink physical pitch solely to fit a large array.
required_engineering: correct final-surface roughness and correlation statistics

memory_examples_only.caution: Margins and grid spacings are illustrations, not established production limits. Values below are height-array decimal GB only, excluding buffers, FFT, masks and solver.

geometry_implementation_issue.previous_implementation: Uniform-section elastic rod and full-sphere query; equal-radius capsules were not the new needle shape.
geometry_implementation_issue.target: Variable cross-section energy and derivatives, local stress, actual tapered body clearance and exposed rounded-cap contact, plus heel-anchored assembly.

output_protocol_proposals.success_definition: The complete holding window must end within the search limit.
required_outputs: fixed reaction or spring travel limits
output_protocol_proposals.unknown_policy: Retain all planned samples; report [k/n,(k+u)/n], not unknown-as-observed-failure.
output_protocol_proposals.target_force_role: One of fixed absolute targets .5/1/2 N; all also compared with T/P>=1 and paired P conditions. No sole winner-selection rule is automated.
output_protocol_proposals.absolute_task_requirement_for_inverse_de: Multiple declared absolute targets .5/1/2 N are computed; scientific selection from them is not automated.

work_performed_this_revision: Variable-section rod, fixed mount, actual taper body/cap domain, heel compensation, multiple protocols and recoverable material coarse scan implemented; targeted checks only, full research queue not launched.

material_conditions.basis: public measured-morphology-conditioned synthesis; one original scan per grade
public measured-morphology-conditioned synthesis; one original scan per grade
public measured-morphology-conditioned synthesis; one original scan per grade

screening_proposal.material_aggregation: Report each condition. If ranking across materials, concrete/red_brick/sandpaper each 1/3; sandpaper grades each 1/3 within sandpaper.

controlled_families.transform: g+0.35*(g^2-1) and its negative, normalized; retain intentional cross-family pairing

fine.allocation: 24 candidates + up to 24 fixed-mount pairs + 8 fixed representatives + up to 40 local refinements; deduplicate

confirmation.allocation: 8 fixed representatives + 4 finalists + up to 4 fixed-mount pairs; deduplicate

controlled_mechanism_arm.scope: Reference 4x4 angle/stiffness/tip-radius and gradient comparison; do not re-cross all layout candidates. Additional final confirmation will be specified separately.

screening_proposal.fixed_representatives: r50/100 crossed with fixed mount and ks100/800/5000 at uniform theta70, 4x4, spacing5mm, rated spring travel4mm
screening_proposal.count_note: Prior seven-load path totals are withdrawn. Current organization is scientific planning, not executed batches.
screening_proposal.precision: Coarse/fine changes candidate coverage and independent repeats; not lower physical discretization.

sandpaper_evidence.array_use: Original short side is about 1 mm, insufficient for current array footprints. Use explicitly measured-conditioned synthetic large fields, not 'measured large wall'.
sandpaper_evidence.independent_repetition: Random synthesis repeats are not independent measured specimens.
sandpaper_evidence.experimental_role: Controlled material benchmark with P40/P100/P240; independent future specimens validate array mechanics. Grade alone does not guarantee identical topography or friction.
